item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
To combat gun violence funding has been allocated to Saturday Night Lights (SNL) programing in areas where there has been an increase in crime. SNL is a youth development program that activated spaces throughout the city to provide free high-quality sports and fitness training for youth aged 11-18. These New York City neighborhoods identified based on the analysis of crime data and TRIE neighborhood review. Some located near where the precinct is listed in the top 30 precincts with the highest shootings in New York City.
